(2) The doctor uses a yellow plastic ruler and a white marking pen to draw precise lines on the patient's right cheek. The scene is a close-up focusing on the hands and the facial marking procedure. (3) The scene shifts to a medical monitor displaying an ultrasound image of skin layers. (4) The doctor is shown applying a white medical treatment device to the patient's face. The device emits a blue light indicator. The camera follows the device's movement across the skin. (5) The doctor stands in a bright clinic area, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. She is seen in a medium full shot. (6) A final title card appears on a white background, featuring the clinic's logo, contact details, and address in black text.
